text_blocks.snippet: "ODH" most commonly stands for the Ohio Department of Health. It is the state's public health agency, responsible for protecting and improving the health of all Ohioans. However, ODH can also refer to "Occupational Data for Health" which is a CDC initiative.

list.snippet: Ohio Department of Health: As mentioned, this is the most common meaning.
Occupational Data for Health: This is a CDC initiative focused on collecting standardized occupational information in electronic health records.
Other: ODH can also stand for "RAF Odiham", a Royal Air Force station, or be an abbreviation in Latin-script writing. In some cases, it can also refer to a specific enzyme, D-octopine dehydrogenase.
